cover.desc: Full color, cold palette with one warm accent. Three figures small at the bottom of a vast dark stair that climbs out of frame — Kou in the black high-collared coat with his sword low in one hand, Kanade beside him with her pale hair loose and her bare hands open, PIKE a step behind with his hands in his pockets. Above them the stair disappears into a pale, almost white void, painted flat with hard-edged shadow shapes. Teal and slate blues, one warm amber lamp at the foot of the stair, colored linework, generous negative space in the upper two thirds.

panels.bg: vast dark stone landing at the top of a stair, an archway ahead filled with pale flat light, dungeon architecture, tone-washed
panels.action: The top of layer thirty-two. The arch is where everybody stops.

dialogue.text: Thursday. Layer thirty-two, cleared.
Everyone in the building knows this arch.
Eleven teams have stood here. Eleven teams have gone home.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: grinning, hair down, entirely at home
chars.pose: sitting on a broken block, boots swinging

panels.bg: dark landing, pale light from the arch, tone-washed
panels.action: They have forty minutes of air and are arguing about a completely different thing.

dialogue.text: You put too much water in it. That's the whole problem.
Four cups is the number.
Four cups is somebody else's number in a library book.

chars.name: pike
chars.pose: leaning on the wall, hands in pockets

panels.action: PIKE has been listening to this for six minutes.

dialogue.text: We are on the roof of the world.
The two best divers alive. Discussing rice.
It's important rice.

panels.action: Comedy spike, forty seconds before the worst thing that has happened to them.

dialogue.text: I AM TWENTY. I AM ON TWELVE. I DID NOT COME HERE FOR RICE.
Then contribute. How much water.
...Three and a half.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: looking at the arch, not at them
chars.pose: standing, sword resting on his shoulder

panels.bg: the arch, flat pale light, tone-washed
panels.action: He has been looking at the arch for a while.

dialogue.text: Three and a half. Write it down.
Hazama.
I want to look at thirty-three.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: off the block, all business, grin gone
chars.pose: standing, hands loose at her sides

chars.name: pike
chars.pose: hands coming out of his pockets

panels.action: The register in the room changes in about a second and a half.

dialogue.text: Look at it, or go through it.
Look at it. Thirty metres. Then out.
That's what the Sasaki team said. On the record. In writing.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: serious for once, one eye steady

panels.action: PIKE does the thing he is actually here for.

dialogue.text: Eleven teams. Four came back short a person.
Nobody's ever come back short a layer. It doesn't take one. It takes several.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: flicking a look sideways at Kou

panels.action: She looks at him and he does not look back.

dialogue.text: He's on nine.
Several would take him past ten, and I know what ten is now.

panels.action: He makes the argument he has been making to himself for a week.

dialogue.text: Thirty metres and out. We map the first room and we go home.
Nobody has ever mapped the first room.

panels.bg: toward the arch, pale light, tone-washed
panels.action: She does not argue. She moves.

dialogue.text: Thirty metres. I'm counting them out loud.
Fine.
I want it noted that I said something sensible.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: standing just inside a vast pale space, sword low

panels.bg: an enormous white room with no visible ceiling, flat pale void, thin black architectural lines suggesting scale, drifting motes, no shadows anywhere, dungeon interior, tone-washed with heavy negative space
panels.action: Layer thirty-three. It is white, and empty, and it does not look dangerous at all.

dialogue.text: One. Two. Three.
It's white.
It's white.
Six. Seven. Eight.
Thirty-two layers of black stone and wet.
And the one nobody can clear is a bright empty room with nothing in it.
No floor seams. No joins. Somebody built this smooth.
Eleven. Twelve. Thirteen.
Keep to my left.
I'm always on your left.
Are we all pretending this is normal? We're pretending.
Nothing to hit. Nothing to hide behind.
Sixteen. Seventeen.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: walking with her hands open and low

panels.bg: vast white room, faint floor line, no other features, tone-washed
panels.action: Twenty metres in. Nothing has happened.

dialogue.text: Nineteen. Twenty.
Anyone else find this worse than monsters?
Considerably worse.

panels.action: PIKE stops first. He is on twelve and he notices things the others don't have to.

dialogue.text: Ariake. Say something else.
Twenty-four?
...Right. Yeah. Everybody out.

panels.action: Kou hears it a second later.

dialogue.text: Her voice is arriving late.
Half a second late. She's two metres away.

panels.action: She works it out from their faces, not from the room.

dialogue.text: What. What is it.
The room's charging us for the walk in.
That's not how it works. It charges at the clear.

panels.action: PIKE says the thing nobody has ever been able to report.

dialogue.text: On thirty-three it charges you for being in the room.
That's why nobody's mapped it. Move.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: moving, hand out to push her back

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: resisting for half a second, then moving

panels.bg: white void, the arch tiny and far behind them, tone-washed
panels.action: Thirty metres in is a long way when the room is charging by the second.

dialogue.text: Go. Straight line. Don't count.
I'm not leaving you at the back.
I'm not at the back. I'm behind you. It's different.

panels.action: PIKE runs and narrates, because that is how he manages fear.

dialogue.text: Nineteen metres. This is the fastest I have moved in a year.
Also I can't tell if I'm out of breath, so somebody watch me.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: running, eyes wide, listening to herself

panels.action: She hears her own footsteps arrive after her feet land.

dialogue.text: My feet are landing before the sound.
It's taking hearing. It's taking hearing first.

panels.bg: white void, the room behind entirely featureless, tone-washed
panels.action: There is nothing behind them. That is somehow much worse.

dialogue.text: Nothing is chasing us.
There is nothing in here at all. That's the design.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: running figure ahead of him, hair streaming

panels.bg: flat white tone field, two solid black running silhouettes, the dark arch a small rectangle ahead
panels.action: Two shapes crossing a white field toward a small black door.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: through the arch, hands on knees
chars.pose: doubled over on the dark landing

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: through, spinning immediately to look back

panels.bg: the dark landing of thirty-two, the white arch behind them, tone-washed
panels.action: Two of them are through.

dialogue.text: Out. I'm out. Somebody count heads.
Null.
NULL.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: coming through the arch, upright, unhurried
chars.pose: stepping out of the white into the dark

panels.bg: the arch, pale light behind, dark stone ahead, tone-washed
panels.action: He walks out of it. He does not stumble.

dialogue.text: I'm here.
You were four seconds behind me.
I was three.
Three, four — I don't care which. You were behind me.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: hands closing on his coat front

panels.action: She checks him the way she checks a strap.

dialogue.text: He walked. Did you see that? He walked out.
Say something.
Something.
Don't. Can you hear me properly?

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: a beat too long before answering
chars.pose: looking at her mouth, not her eyes

panels.action: He answers a beat late, and watches her mouth while she talks.

dialogue.text: He will. I'll be in the corridor.
You don't have to wait.
I can hear you.
I can hear her. It's fine. It's arriving fine.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: upright again, watching the two of them

panels.action: PIKE watches and files it.

dialogue.text: Booths. All three of us. Tonight, not tomorrow.
Agreed.
It's fine.
Booth four's your sister. Tell her the truth, not the version.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: flat, seated at the booth desk
chars.pose: clipboard, headset, one hand on a dial

panels.bg: calibration booth, numbered, clinical, one lamp, tone-washed
panels.action: Booth four. Half past midnight.

dialogue.text: Tone at forty. Say when you hear it.
Now.
Tone at twenty-five.
Now.
Tone at ten. Left or right.

panels.action: Nothing.

dialogue.text: There's a tone. I can tell there's a tone.
I can't tell where it is in the room.

panels.action: She writes it down without any change in her face.

dialogue.text: Left or right.
...Left.
It was behind you.
Again. Tone at forty, one metre.

panels.bg: flat tone field, a calibration form on a clipboard, a printed grid, one figure written in a small flat hand, tone-washed
panels.action: The number on the form.

dialogue.text: You will. That isn't the point either.
HAZAMA K. — COUNT: 10
THREAD LOST: DIRECTIONAL HEARING

chars.name: shizu
chars.pose: holding the clipboard against her chest

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: already standing, reaching for his jacket

panels.action: Neither of them says the number out loud.

dialogue.text: You can still hear. You can't locate.
That's a small one.
It's the one that tells you what's behind you.
I'll learn it. Two days.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: waiting in the corridor, coat over her arm
chars.pose: standing against the wall opposite booth four

panels.bg: corridor of numbered booths, night, one strip light, tone-washed
panels.action: She has been in the corridor for twenty minutes and her own test took four.

dialogue.text: Mine came back clean. Not a thread.
I was in that room the same length of time he was.

panels.action: He comes out and does the mild face.

dialogue.text: Well?
Small one.
That is not a number, Hazama.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: level, giving her the fact because she asked properly

panels.action: He gives it to her, because she is the person he gives things to now.

dialogue.text: Ten.
I can hear. I can't tell where from.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: keeping her face completely still, costing her

panels.action: She does not do a thing with her face. It is becoming a skill.

dialogue.text: Do not do the face. He will close like a door.
Ten. He said ten on a crossing eight days ago and it was already ten.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: practical, moving to his left side

panels.action: She solves it in the only way she knows and does not announce it.

dialogue.text: I'll walk on this side.
Why.
Because I'm telling you what's behind us. Obviously.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: on his left, half a step back

panels.bg: night street outside the academy, low walls, lamplight, tone-washed
panels.action: She starts describing the road behind them, and does not stop for eleven minutes.

dialogue.text: Bicycle, forty metres back, slow. A man with a bag, other side.
You don't have to do this.
A cat. Behind the machine. Very committed to something.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the smallest change at the mouth

panels.action: He does not tell her to stop again.

dialogue.text: This is the second thing she has done like this.
Nobody has ever done one.

panels.action: The inventory continues past the point of usefulness.

dialogue.text: Two shutters. One vending machine. The cat is winning.
Winning what?
I don't have that information, Hazama.

panels.bg: blank background, comedy screentone, small cat
panels.action: Register switch.

dialogue.text: CAT. STILL BEHIND US. STATUS UNCHANGED.
Understood.
I AM A VERY GOOD SYSTEM.

panels.action: He stops at the corner where they always split.

dialogue.text: Saturday. The rice.
Three and a half cups. Pike's number.
We're not using Pike's number.

chars.name: nabari
chars.pose: standing at the front of a small office

panels.bg: supervisor's office, morning, files, a wall chart of layers, tone-washed
panels.action: Friday morning. The institution has noticed.

dialogue.text: Three calibrations in one night. One thread lost.
The log says thirty-two. The log is lying to me.

panels.action: She lies with the assembly voice and it is genuinely impressive.

dialogue.text: We stood at the arch, sir. We looked in. We came back.
And the lost thread?
Thirty-two was long.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: looking at her over the folder, not fooled

panels.action: He is not a fool. He is a man with a folder.

dialogue.text: Ariake. I have four hundred students and one of you is worth eleven of the rest.
That is not a compliment. It's a staffing problem.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: sitting down heavily, rubbing his eyes
chars.pose: dropping the folder on the desk

panels.action: He does the thing he privately thinks is wrong.

dialogue.text: Thirty-three is closed. Faculty order, from today.
Sir.
Don't. I've read what's in that room. Nothing. That's the point.

panels.action: Her face does not move.

dialogue.text: That's the second ban I've been given this year.
I have broken the first one forty-three times.

chars.name: gen
chars.pose: dropping onto the bench beside Kou

panels.bg: school courtyard bench, midday, bright, tone-washed
panels.action: Friday lunch. The ordinary world, running on schedule.

dialogue.text: You look worse than usual and that's a genuine achievement.
You said that in March.
It was true in March.

panels.action: Gen talks and Kou watches his mouth, because that is what he does now.

dialogue.text: Anyway, Saturday, I was thinking — arcade, then that place with the—
I've got a thing on Saturday.
A THING. He has a THING.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: turning his head deliberately to hear which side

panels.action: Somebody shouts across the yard and Kou turns the wrong way.

dialogue.text: Wrong side. That was the other side.
Two days. I'll learn it in two days.

panels.action: Gen notices and gets it completely wrong in the kindest possible way.

dialogue.text: Other way, mate. You've gone deaf from all that counting.
Must have.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the mild face on, eyes flat

panels.action: The joke is accurate and he cannot say so.

dialogue.text: He's right. He's completely right and he'll never know it.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: blocking a corridor, tablet under her arm

panels.bg: school corridor, afternoon light through tall windows, tone-washed
panels.action: Riko has done six days of quiet arithmetic and has reached a total.

dialogue.text: You had a calibration on Thursday night.
Routine.
You've had eleven this year. Nobody in the top stream has eleven.

panels.action: The committee smile does not work on somebody who has watched it develop.

dialogue.text: Riko—
Don't do that at me. I helped you build that.

panels.action: She lays it out without triumph.

dialogue.text: You're diving. Under the ban. With him.
I'm not going to tell anyone. I want you to hear me say it out loud.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: leaning back against the window frame

panels.action: She stops performing, in daylight, for the second time this year.

dialogue.text: Then say the rest of it.
He's on ten and you're on nothing, and you can't work out why.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: hands going slack on her books

panels.action: She has not let herself finish that thought until somebody else said it.

dialogue.text: Thirteen months. Every layer, both of us, the same rooms.
He's lost ten. I've lost none. That isn't luck.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: sitting on a low wall, feet swinging, eating chips

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing over him, arms folded, demanding

panels.bg: outside a shop near the academy, late afternoon, tone-washed
panels.action: She has tracked PIKE down and is not doing small talk.

dialogue.text: Why is he on ten and I'm on nothing?
Straight in. No hello. I like it.
Kirisu.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: chewing, thinking, one eye on her

panels.action: He gives her the real answer, which he has never given anyone.

dialogue.text: It charges whoever's holding the line.
Not who's strongest. Who's standing between it and the other one.

panels.action: Thirteen months rearrange themselves behind her eyes.

dialogue.text: He takes the left. He always takes the left.
I thought it was because I'm faster on the right.

chars.name: pike
chars.pose: not looking at her, looking at the road

panels.action: He does not soften it and he does not enjoy it.

dialogue.text: Thirteen months, Ariake. Every room. He's been paying your bill.
And he'd do it again tomorrow, so don't go and be noble at him.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: standing alone on an empty street

panels.bg: flat tone field, one solid silhouette against a pale evening sky, telephone wires
panels.action: She stands in the road for a while.

dialogue.text: Ten threads. Ten of them are mine.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: at the stove, sleeves up, absorbed
chars.pose: cooking, tea towel over one shoulder

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting on the counter, quiet, watching him
chars.pose: legs still, hands in her lap

panels.bg: the apartment kitchen, Saturday morning, warm light, tone-washed
panels.action: Saturday. The rota. She has not said anything for four minutes.

dialogue.text: Three and a half cups.
Pike's number.
We're testing it. That's different from using it.
Pike measured it with a mug. He told me. Proudly.
Then it's a mug's number.
It's a Kirisu number. Same thing.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: watching his hands, not his face

panels.action: She watches him work and does the arithmetic she cannot stop doing.

dialogue.text: Taste. Smell. Hot. Cold. Most of pain. Grip. Weather.
And now the thing that tells him what's behind him. All of it for me.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: holding out the spoon without looking

panels.action: He holds the spoon out backwards. It is completely automatic now.

dialogue.text: Taste it.
You didn't even look.
You're always in the same place.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: tasting, eyes closing, and then it goes wrong

panels.action: She tastes it and her face does something she cannot stop.

dialogue.text: You said 'no' with your whole face first.

panels.action: He turns round because she has been quiet for three seconds.

dialogue.text: Is it wrong?
No.
Ariake.
It's fine. It's good, actually. Better than last week.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: putting the spoon down very carefully
chars.pose: both hands flat on the counter

panels.action: She asks it flat, because there is no good way round it.

dialogue.text: Why do you always take the left.
You're faster on the right.
Kirisu says it charges whoever holds the line.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: no reaction at all, which is the reaction

panels.action: He does not deny it. He does not do the mild face either, which frightens her more.

dialogue.text: He shouldn't have told you that.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: voice rising, hands off the counter

panels.action: She does not shout. She gets very precise, which is worse.

dialogue.text: Thirteen months. Ten threads. You made that decision alone every time.
Yes.
You didn't ask me.

panels.action: He hands her own words back and it lands like a brick.

dialogue.text: You'd have said no.
Yes. That's what asking is.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not backing down, not raising his voice

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: gripping the counter edge behind her

panels.action: Two people using each other's sentences.

dialogue.text: You did it to me with Pike. I'm doing it to you with the left.
That was a ROSTER. This is your HEARING.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: standing in the middle of the small kitchen

panels.bg: kitchen, the pan still going, tone-washed
panels.action: The rice is still cooking. Neither of them turns it off.

dialogue.text: I want it stopped.
No.
Then I'm not diving.

panels.action: The one threat that works.

dialogue.text: She means it. She never says things she doesn't mean.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: honest, which is rare and costs him

panels.action: He tells her the true thing, in the only grammar he owns.

dialogue.text: You're first in the year. You've got a whole life queued up.
I've got a blank pin and a sword I'm not allowed to carry.

panels.action: She hears the arithmetic underneath it.

dialogue.text: He worked out that he was worth less. Years ago. Quietly.
And then he just started paying.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stepping in close, not touching him

panels.action: She does not comfort him. She corrects the arithmetic.

dialogue.text: Then you've made an error, and I'm very good at those.
Left is mine on Thursday. That's not a request.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: quiet, worn out, faintly amused despite it
chars.pose: sitting on the floor against the cupboards

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting next to him, knees up

panels.bg: kitchen floor, afternoon light, the pan finally off, tone-washed
panels.action: They end up on the floor of a two-room flat, not looking at each other.

dialogue.text: The rice is ruined.
It's not ruined. It's evidence.
Against Pike.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: matter-of-fact, staring at the opposite wall

panels.action: She starts the inventory again, unprompted.

dialogue.text: It's warm in here. Properly warm, not stuffy.
The rice smells burnt at the edges and fine in the middle.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: head back against the cupboard door

panels.bg: flat tone, warm, soft bokeh, tone-washed
panels.action: He listens to a description of a room he is sitting in.

dialogue.text: Keep going.
There's a cat outside. Probably the same one. Unclear what it wants.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: in the doorway, flat, holding two mugs
chars.pose: looking down at the two of them on her kitchen floor

panels.action: Shizu comes home and finds them on the floor.

dialogue.text: You're on the floor.
We are.
All right.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: dot eyes, unbothered, stepping over them

panels.action: Register switch, one panel.

dialogue.text: I AM ON YOUR FLOOR. I APOLOGISE FOR BEING ON YOUR FLOOR.
It's a floor.
She's not being sad at you.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the dormitory at night, notebook open

panels.bg: dormitory room, desk lamp, night, tone-washed
panels.action: Half eleven. The list has more entries now.

dialogue.text: Warm kitchen floor — warm, not stuffy.
Burnt rice — sharp at the edges, fine in the middle.
Cat — status unknown.

panels.action: She turns to a clean page and writes something that is not a description.

dialogue.text: Thirty-three charges whoever holds the line.
So the line has to be mine.

panels.action: She sends two messages and lies to somebody for the first time in the series.

dialogue.text: Thursday. Hall two. Half seven.
And I've spoken to Nabari. It's fine. Don't worry about the ban.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: staring at the ceiling, face flat

panels.action: She has not spoken to Nabari.

dialogue.text: I have not spoken to Nabari.
He asked me once whether I'd say no.
So I'm not giving him the chance.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: reading the message in the dark, mild
chars.pose: sitting on the futon, phone glow on his face

panels.action: Four streets away, he reads it and believes her completely.

dialogue.text: She's never lied to me.
Thursday. Left is hers.
That's going to be fine. That's going to be completely fine.
